posts.preview: This morning, I participated in a Stakeholders’ Workshop on the review of the Social Security Act and the Compensation for Work-Related Accidents and Diseases Act
The two Acts are being reviewed to address the socioeconomic development challenges faced by our people and to strengthen social protection for Namibian workers

We are moving in the right direction, as stakeholders are discussing important issues such as the “bread and butter” funds and the inclusion of the informal sector in the social security system See less
